Network Traffic 0.1.0

Product inspiration and capability reference:
  Sniffnet by Giuliano Bellini and contributors
  https://github.com/GyulyVGC/sniffnet
  Source identity reviewed: c8c68b503eda5e919e1f715cf7048c0cd2eabddf
  Upstream licenses: Apache-2.0 OR MIT

This plugin is an independent Swift/libpcap implementation for the TraceFence
MacToolsPluginKit host. It does not contain or bundle Sniffnet source code,
assets, binaries, MaxMind databases, or the iced user interface.

System dependency:
  libpcap, provided by macOS.
